metadata.title: Twisted Patterson-Sullivan densities on nilpotent covers for Anosov subgroups
metadata.abstract: Let $\Gamma<\mathsf{SL}(d,\mathbb R)$ be a Zariski-dense Borel-Anosov subgroup and let $\varphi$ be positive on its limit cone. For every $\chi \in \mathrm{Hom}(\Gamma, \mathbb R)$, we construct twisted $(\varphi,\chi)$-conformal densities and prove their uniqueness, atomlessness, and ergodicity. For every normal subgroup $\Gamma_0\lhd\Gamma$ with nilpotent quotient, we classify the ergodic $\varphi$-conformal densities of $\Gamma_0$ in terms of characters of $\Gamma/\Gamma_0$.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.progressType: 幂零覆叠上的扭曲共形密度
analysis.workSummary: 为 Zariski 稠密 Borel–Anosov 子群构造扭曲 Patterson–Sullivan 密度并证明唯一性、无原子性和遍历性，按商群特征分类幂零覆叠的遍历共形密度。
analysis.breakthrough: 把共形密度分类推广到指定幂零商情形。
analysis.limitations: 要求 Borel–Anosov、Zariski 稠密和极限锥上的正性；稿件标为初步版本。
analysis.priorityReason: 把共形密度分类推广到指定幂零商情形。
